titleEn: AquaSpy Rebrands as UnderGround Weather, Introducing the World’s First AI Soil Intelligence Reporting Engine
titleZh: AquaSpy更名为UnderGround Weather，推出全球首个人工智能土壤情报报告引擎
summaryZh: AquaSpy公司宣布更名为UnderGround Weather，并推出全球首个AI土壤情报报告引擎UnderGround Weather Reporter。该技术基于近20年的地下传感数据，连续监测根区硝酸盐、水分、氧化还原电位、盐度和温度，结合AI生成可操作报告，帮助种植者和农艺师实时了解地下环境变化，替代传统的点状土壤采样，标志着从周期性监测向连续地下智能的转变。
featuredReason: 该新闻展示了土壤传感与AI结合的最新趋势，对智慧畜牧中的精准种植和饲料原料管理具有重要参考价值，值得关注其技术路径和商业模式。
contentFull:
By UnderGround Weather 

 

 Share

 

 

 

 

 

 AquaSpy, an agtech company that builds continuous, multi-depth in-soil nitrate and moisture sensing, has announced it is rebranding as UnderGround Weather and launching a new category of soil intelligence, giving growers the same continuous visibility into conditions below the surface that they have long had above it.

 Built on nearly two decades of underground sensing, UnderGround Weather replaces point-in-time soil sampling with a continuous, multi-depth view of the root zone — tracking nitrate and the other conditions that drive nutrient availability as they shift through the season.

 Until now, agronomists have relied on a combination of soil sampling, field observations, weather data, and experience to understand what is happening below the surface. UnderGround Weather creates a continuous view of the underground environment, helping growers and advisors see how nutrients, moisture, oxygen, temperature, and biology change throughout the season.

 “For nearly two decades, we’ve helped growers see what’s happening beneath their fields,” said Bruce Moeller, CEO. “Calling it UnderGround Weather names what we’ve long believed: the root zone has its own weather, and growers deserve to read it as clearly as they read the sky.” As part of the rebrand, the company also introduced UnderGround Weather Reporter™, the world’s first AI soil intelligence reporting engine.

 UnderGround Weather Reporter automatically analyzes underground measurements, weather conditions, soil characteristics, crop activity, and management events to generate concise reports explaining what is happening in the root zone, why it matters, and what actions deserve attention.

 Digital Agriculture’s Role in the Future of Crop Protection

 

 

 UnderGround Weather is powered by Crophesy™ LS-N, which continuously measures nitrate, oxidation-reduction potential (ORP), moisture, salinity, and temperature throughout the root zone. These direct measurements provide the foundation for AI-powered interpretation and recommendations. This physical AI approach provides intelligence grounded in real, multi-depth measurement inside the soil rather than models or imagery alone.

 “Most agricultural AI begins with assumptions and models,” Moeller said. “UnderGround Weather Reporter begins with direct measurement. First, we measure reality. Then AI helps explain what it means.”

 The launch follows deployment of the technology across more than 900 nutrient management subscriptions spanning multiple crops, growing regions, and countries. UnderGround Weather is built on billions of underground measurements collected through nearly two decades of field experience.

 The company believes the introduction of UnderGround Weather represents a shift from periodic soil monitoring toward continuous underground intelligence.

 “Growers have weather reports. Agronomists have soil samples. What has been missing is a way to continuously understand how underground conditions are changing between those moments,” Moeller said. “That’s the gap UnderGround Weather is designed to fill.”

translationZh:
AquaSpy，一家开发连续、多深度土壤硝酸盐和水分传感技术的农业科技公司，宣布更名为UnderGround Weather，并推出一个全新的土壤情报类别，让种植者能够像长期观察地上天气一样，持续洞察地表以下的条件。

基于近二十年的地下传感技术积累，UnderGround Weather用连续、多深度的根区视图取代了瞬时土壤采样，追踪硝酸盐及其他影响养分有效性的条件随季节变化的情况。

迄今为止，农艺师依赖土壤采样、田间观察、天气数据和经验相结合的方式来了解地表以下的情况。UnderGround Weather创建了地下环境的连续视图，帮助种植者和顾问了解养分、水分、氧气、温度和生物活性在整个季节中的变化。

“近二十年来，我们帮助种植者看到他们田地下面发生的事情，”首席执行官Bruce Moeller表示。“将其命名为UnderGround Weather，正是我们长期以来的信念：根区有自己的天气，种植者应该像阅读天空一样清晰地阅读它。”作为品牌重塑的一部分，公司还推出了UnderGround Weather Reporter™，这是全球首个AI土壤情报报告引擎。

UnderGround Weather Reporter自动分析地下测量数据、天气条件、土壤特性、作物活动和管理事件，生成简明报告，解释根区正在发生什么、为什么重要，以及哪些行动值得关注。

UnderGround Weather由Crophesy™ LS-N提供支持，该设备连续测量根区的硝酸盐、氧化还原电位（ORP）、水分、盐度和温度。这些直接测量为AI驱动的解读和建议提供了基础。这种物理AI方法提供的智能基于土壤内部真实的多深度测量，而非仅依赖模型或图像。

“大多数农业AI始于假设和模型，”Moeller表示。“UnderGround Weather Reporter始于直接测量。首先，我们测量现实。然后AI帮助解释其含义。”

此次发布之前，该技术已在900多个养分管理订阅中部署，涵盖多种作物、种植区域和国家。UnderGround Weather建立在近二十年田间经验中收集的数十亿次地下测量数据之上。

公司认为，UnderGround Weather的推出代表了从周期性土壤监测向连续地下智能的转变。

“种植者有天气报告。农艺师有土壤样本。一直缺少的是持续了解地下条件在这些时刻之间如何变化的方法，”Moeller表示。“这正是UnderGround Weather旨在填补的空白。”
author: Matt Hopkins
